blocks.title: Cloud computing
blocks.text: Cloud computing gives easy access over the internet to computing resources such as servers, storage and applications, which can be provided and released quickly with little management effort.

It is like renting a powerful computer that you reach over the internet: instead of buying and maintaining your own machines, you use as much or as little as you need, from anywhere, and pay only for what you use.

blocks.prompt: Give two advantages of cloud computing over buying your own servers.
blocks.explanation: No large upfront hardware cost or maintenance, and resources can grow or shrink with need, paid only for use.

items: Cloud computing: rent computing resources over the internet; pay for what you use.
